areas.name: DHA Phase 6
areas.h1: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 6 — From Our Kitchen Next Door
areas.title: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 6, Karachi
areas.description: Cheese O’Clock’s kitchen is in Rahat Commercial, Phase 6 — our shortest ride. Pizza & burgers, Rs 200 delivery, cash on delivery. Open daily till 1 am.
intro: Phase 6 is home turf. Our kitchen is at Shop 3, Ground Floor, 41-C, Sehar Lane No. 3, Rahat Commercial Area, DHA Phase 6, so Phase 6 is the shortest ride we make. Every order is fired when it comes in, boxed straight from the oven and sent out hot.

From the Bukhari Commercial lanes to the houses off Khayaban-e-Shahbaz, delivery anywhere in Phase 6 is Rs 200. Late study session, family dinner or a midnight craving — we are open every day from 1 pm until 1 am.

popular.name: Cheesy Star
popular.blurb: Cut like a star, built for sharing, with a Sriracha mayo dip. One of our five Signature pizzas, Large 12".

popular.name: Crown Crust
popular.blurb: Another Signature Large 12" — pair it with a Cheesy Star when there are more than two of you.

popular.name: Signature Loaded Fries
popular.blurb: Pick-up only — we do not deliver these. Living in Phase 6, you are close enough to collect them from the shop in Rahat Commercial.

faqs.q: Is Phase 6 your quickest delivery area?
faqs.a: Yes — the kitchen is in Rahat Commercial, Phase 6, so it is the shortest ride we make. Orders are fired when they arrive and sent out hot. Delivery inside Phase 6 is Rs 200.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to Bukhari and Nishat Commercial offices?
faqs.a: Yes — offices, shops and apartments across all Phase 6 commercial lanes. Add your building name and floor in the order notes and keep your phone on for the rider.

faqs.q: How late can I order in Phase 6?
faqs.a: We take orders every day from 1 pm until 1 am — on the website, or on WhatsApp at 0300 9367865 or 0331 2188295.

faqs.q: How do I pay?
faqs.a: Cash on delivery — pay the rider when your food arrives. Your bill is the menu total plus 15% tax and the Rs 200 delivery fee. No card or app required.

areas.name: DHA Phase 7
areas.h1: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 7, Karachi
areas.title: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 7, Karachi
areas.description: Pizza & crispy chicken burger delivery to DHA Phase 7 and Phase 7 Ext from our Phase 6 kitchen next door. Rs 200 delivery, cash on delivery.
intro: Phase 7 sits right next to our Phase 6 kitchen, so your order is on its way while the cheese is still moving. Every pizza and burger is fired when the ticket comes in.

We cover the whole phase — the residential streets off Khayaban-e-Sehar, Sehar and Jami Commercial, and Phase 7 Extension — for Rs 200. If you are unsure about your street, send us a WhatsApp before you order.

popular.name: Shawarma Pizza
popular.blurb: A Signature Large 12" — shawarma night and pizza night, settled in one box.

popular.name: Nashville Authentic (Hot)
popular.blurb: A thigh-marinated crispy chicken fillet in a brioche bun, Nashville-style and properly hot. Add cheese to any burger.

popular.name: Baked Wings
popular.blurb: Six oven-baked wings with a dip — baked, not fried.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to Phase 7 Extension?
faqs.a: Yes — Phase 7 Extension has its own option at checkout, at the same Rs 200 fee as Phase 7.

faqs.q: Which area do I pick at checkout?
faqs.a: DHA Phase 7, or DHA Phase 7 Extension if you are in Ext. If your street sits on the Phase 6 border, either is fine — the fee is Rs 200 both ways.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum order for Phase 7?
faqs.a: No minimum on the website. You pay cash on delivery: the menu total plus 15% tax and the Rs 200 delivery fee.

areas.name: DHA Phase 8
areas.h1: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 8, Karachi
areas.title: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 8, Karachi
areas.description: Pizza & burgers delivered across DHA Phase 8 — Do Darya side, Emaar Crescent Bay & Creek Vista included. Rs 250 delivery, cash on delivery, till 1 am.
intro: Phase 8 runs wide — from the Zulfiqar and Al-Murtaza commercial strips out to the sea at Do Darya — and we deliver across all of it. Orders leave our Phase 6 kitchen boxed straight from the oven.

Delivery is Rs 250 across Phase 8, the same for Emaar Crescent Bay and Creek Vista, which are their own zones at checkout. Do Darya plans fell through? Skip the restaurant queue, order in and pay the rider cash.

popular.name: Big Two value deal
popular.blurb: Two Large 12" regular-menu pizzas and a 1 litre soft drink — the value deal for a full house.

popular.name: Meat Lovers
popular.blurb: A Signature Large 12" for the meat-first crowd.

popular.name: Nuggets
popular.blurb: Five nuggets with fries and a dip — a side that is nearly a meal.

faqs.q: Do you deliver near Do Darya?
faqs.a: Yes — the Do Darya side is covered at the Phase 8 fee of Rs 250.

faqs.q: Why is delivery to Phase 8 Rs 250?
faqs.a: Phase 8 — with Emaar Crescent Bay and Creek Vista — is Rs 250 on our rider service’s rate card, instead of the Rs 200 for Phases 1–7. Pick your area at checkout and the right fee is added for you.

faqs.q: Will the food still be hot in Phase 8?
faqs.a: Orders are boxed straight from the oven and sent out as soon as they are ready. If anything is not right when it arrives, message us on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Can I order late at night in Phase 8?
faqs.a: Yes — we take Phase 8 orders every day until 1 am.

areas.name: DHA Phase 5
areas.h1: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 5, Karachi
areas.title: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 5, Karachi
areas.description: Pizza & crispy chicken burgers delivered across DHA Phase 5 — Khadda Market, 26th Street, Badar Commercial. Rs 200 delivery, cash on delivery.
intro: Phase 5 neighbours our Phase 6 kitchen, so the ride from oven to gate is a short one — from the Khadda Market lanes to the quieter streets off Khayaban-e-Tanzeem. Delivery anywhere in Phase 5 is Rs 200.

Phase 5 has plenty of food, but most of it means going out. We bring it home instead: crispy chicken burgers in brioche buns, Medium or Large pizzas with a proper cheese pull, and masala fries — all paid in cash at your door.

popular.name: Classic Crispy Chicken
popular.blurb: A thigh-marinated crispy chicken fillet in a brioche bun — the straightforward one. Add cheese if you like.

popular.name: Chicken Tikka Pizza
popular.blurb: From the regular menu, in Medium 9" or Large 12".

popular.name: Signature Masala Fries
popular.blurb: A Large portion of fries in our masala — the side that goes with everything.

faqs.q: Do you deliver around Khadda Market?
faqs.a: Yes — Khadda Market and the lanes around it are covered at the standard Phase 5 fee of Rs 200.

faqs.q: Do you cover all of 26th Street?
faqs.a: Yes, the full stretch. For apartment buildings, add the building name in your order notes and keep your phone on for the rider.

faqs.q: Can I pay by card?
faqs.a: Not at the moment — every order is cash on delivery. The bill is the menu total plus 15% tax and the Rs 200 delivery fee.

areas.name: DHA Phase 4
areas.h1: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 4, Karachi
areas.title: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 4, Karachi
areas.description: Pizza & crispy chicken burgers delivered to DHA Phase 4 and Phase 3 — 9th Commercial, Sunset side and the residential lanes. Rs 200, cash on delivery.
intro: Phase 4 sits between our kitchen and the older phases, and we deliver across all of it — the Sunset Boulevard side, the 9th Commercial strip and the residential lanes in between. Phase 3 next door is covered too. Delivery to either is Rs 200.
Order on the website in under a minute, or WhatsApp your order and street to 0300 9367865 or 0331 2188295 — both land in the same kitchen, and both are cash on delivery.

popular.name: Classic Pepperoni
popular.blurb: Pepperoni on rich tomato sauce, from the regular menu in Medium 9" or Large 12".

popular.name: Crispy Signature
popular.blurb: A thigh-marinated crispy chicken fillet in a brioche bun — one step up from the Classic.

popular.name: Veggie Lovers
popular.blurb: Choose any five veggies — for the one person in the group who is not feeling meat.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to DHA Phase 3?
faqs.a: Yes — pick DHA Phase 3 at checkout. It is Rs 200, the same as Phase 4.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to offices in 9th Commercial?
faqs.a: Yes — lunch and dinner, from 1 pm. Put the office name and floor in the order notes, and keep your phone close for the rider’s call.

faqs.q: Is WhatsApp ordering available for Phase 4?
faqs.a: Yes. Message your order and address to 0300 9367865 or 0331 2188295 and we will confirm the total right away.

areas.name: DHA Phase 1 & 2
areas.h1: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 1 & 2, Karachi
areas.title: Pizza & Burger Delivery in DHA Phase 1 & 2, Karachi
areas.description: Pizza & burger delivery to DHA Phase 1, Phase 2 and Phase 2 Ext from our Phase 6 kitchen. Rs 200 delivery, cash on delivery — order online or WhatsApp.
intro: Phase 1 and Phase 2 are the longest ride from our Phase 6 kitchen, and we will not pretend otherwise. What does not change is how the food leaves: fired to order, boxed straight from the oven and sent out hot — for the same Rs 200 as Phases 3 to 7.

We cover Phase 1, Phase 2 and Phase 2 Extension: the Korangi Road side, Defence Mor and the Phase 2 Ext lanes. If your street sits right on the boundary, send a WhatsApp and we will confirm before you order.

popular.name: Family Feast value deal
popular.blurb: One Medium and one Large regular-menu pizza with a 1 litre soft drink — makes the longer ride worth it.

popular.name: Signature Cheese Dipped
popular.blurb: A thigh-marinated crispy chicken fillet, dipped in cheese, in a brioche bun.

popular.name: Fajita Pizza
popular.blurb: A regular-menu pizza in Medium 9" or Large 12" — it fits in the Family Feast too.

faqs.q: Do you really deliver this far from Phase 6?
faqs.a: Yes. Phase 1, Phase 2 and Phase 2 Extension are all on our delivery map at the Rs 200 fee for DHA Phases 1–7. It is the longest ride we make, so order a little ahead if you are feeding people at a set time.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to Phase 2 Extension?
faqs.a: Yes, Phase 2 Ext has its own option at checkout. We deliver in DHA and Clifton only, so for boundary streets near Korangi Road, drop us a WhatsApp first and we will confirm your address is in zone.

faqs.q: Is it still cash on delivery this far out?
faqs.a: Always — same as every zone. Pay the rider when the food arrives: the menu total plus 15% tax and the Rs 200 delivery fee.

areas.name: Clifton
areas.h1: Pizza & Burger Delivery in Clifton, Karachi
areas.title: Pizza & Burger Delivery in Clifton, Karachi
areas.description: Pizza & burgers delivered to Clifton Blocks 1–9 — Boat Basin, Schon Circle and beyond. Rs 200 (Blocks 1 & 2: Rs 250). Cash on delivery, open till 1 am.
intro: Clifton has no shortage of food streets — what it lacks at midnight is a kitchen still answering. We deliver across Clifton from our DHA Phase 6 kitchen every day until 1 am, cash on delivery.
Coverage runs across all nine blocks, from Boat Basin and Schon Circle to Bilawal Chowrangi and the Sea View side. Delivery is Rs 200 for Blocks 3–9 and Rs 250 for Blocks 1 and 2.

popular.name: Cheetos
popular.blurb: A Signature Large 12" — fajita chicken and jalapeño with creamy cheese and a hot, tangy red spice, with ranch dip.

popular.name: Perfect Pair value deal
popular.blurb: Two Medium 9" regular-menu pizzas and a 1 litre soft drink — right-sized for two.

popular.name: Chicken Tikka Malai
popular.blurb: The creamy side of tikka, from the regular menu in Medium 9" or Large 12".

faqs.q: Which Clifton blocks do you deliver to?
faqs.a: All of them — Blocks 1 to 9, including Boat Basin and Schon Circle. Delivery is Rs 200 for Blocks 3–9 and Rs 250 for Blocks 1 and 2.

faqs.q: Do you deliver beyond Clifton?
faqs.a: No — we deliver in DHA and Clifton only, and the checkout will not take an address outside those zones.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to apartment towers?
faqs.a: Yes. Add the tower name and apartment number in the order notes, and keep your phone on for the rider.
